Demonstrate the ability to use sequential and contextual AI prompting to rapidly generate complex, interactive web development tools (single-file HTML/CSS/JS applications) for visualizing core concepts like the CSS Box Model and modern layout systems (Flexbox/Grid).
Initial Prompt Formulation and Execution (Box Model Lab): Use the initial prompt provided in the concept page to generate the "Box Model & Display" Interactive Lab. Execute this prompt in an AI tool that can generate single-file HTML/CSS/JS code
# Refinement Prompt and Execution (Side-Specific Controls): Using the code generated in the previous step as context (or through a conversational follow-up if using a tool that retains context), provide the refinement prompt: "Implement sliders to adjust the margin, padding, and border for each side (top, right, bottom, left) individually, and add a separate slider for the corner radius." Execute this second prompt and capture a screenshot of the AI's response containing the refined code.
Flexbox/Grid Playground Generation: Formulate and execute the prompt provided in the concept page for the "Visualizing Flexbox and Grid" Playground. This will be a new, separate web application. Capture a screenshot of the AI's response that contains this new, functional HTML/CSS/JS playground.
